reason: This is a planner-core refactor in one of the highest-blast-radius areas: physical plan enumeration and best-task selection. It touches `exhaust_physical_plans`, `find_best_task`, physical property handling, memo/group expression code, and many logical/physical operator implementations (join, aggregation, CTE, projection, selection, limit, union scan). Even if framed as a refactor, changes here can silently alter optimizer semantics, plan generation, costing, and rule interactions across broad query classes, so it merits a focused Blocker/High deep review.
